interface.name: wana_shell_control_v1
interface.description:
This interface is advertised only to the compositor-launched privileged Wana shell connection. Ordinary clients must never see or bind it.
Version 1 carries compositor-owned global shell actions. The compositor decides which physical input gesture triggers an action; the shell only receives the semantic request and owns the corresponding UI.

event.name: toggle_launcher
event.description: Emitted when the compositor recognizes Wana's launcher shortcut. The shell opens the launcher when closed and closes it when open.
